text:
Nora: Quick PSA 1: the decaf tin is empty and there
s a single soggy chamomile bag left in the box. Who did the late-night tea run? :eyes:
Eli: Oops that was me, grabbed decaf then got distracted. I left a note but forgot to restock. I'll grab a new tin on my way in tomorrow AM. Sorry!
Rina: no stress. can we standardize where extras go? the top shelf gets chaotic. maybe label a 'STOCK' bin? :card_file_box:
Omar: love the stock bin idea. Also can we please adopt a tea taxonomy so we stop the Great Earl Grey vs. Breakfast confusion. proposal: TEA BIN labels: "HERBAL (caffeine-free)", "BLACK/ENGLISH", "GREEN/WHITE", "SPECIALTY". quick, clear.
Felix: +1 on taxonomy. I can make laminated tags and tape them inside the cupboard. I'll also add a tiny legend: caffeine estimate and whether it mixes with oatmilk. :sunglasses:
Nora: legend is brilliant. Also FYI someone left a used french press filter in the sink mdrying like a science project. please don't leave filters.
Eli: guilty again myth busted. I'll clean it now and put a spare filter pack in the STOCK bin.
Rina: I made a tiny printable for the cupboard door:```KITCHEN QUICK: STOCK BIN RULES
- Put extra unopened bags/boxes in STOCK bin
- If you remove the last item, leave a sticky note + write your name
- Don't leave used filters or cups in sink
- Label home-brought jars with initials```
Omar: could we add a small checkbox on the sticky for "restocked" so people know if someone already handled it? tiny wins.
Felix: done. I'll print 6 small signs and a roll of sticky notes. also, is anyone allergic to nuts? planning to bring in a shared jar of spiced granola for next week.
Nora: I'm allergic to tree nuts, thanks for checking! Please mark shared food with contents and date.
Eli: note for the granola: can we keep it in the big clear container with a label that includes allergen info and who brought it? saves confusion.
kitchen-bot: Inventory scan: decaf (0), black tea (4 boxes), green tea (3), oat milk (2), coffee (3 bags). Low items: decaf. Action recommended: reorder decaf.
Rina: Kitchen-bot, bless you. Eli, if you can't pick decaf tomorrow, I'll swing by.
Eli: I can do it. Also adding the laminated tags to my to-do and leaving one spare filter pack in STOCK.
Nora: thanks all 4 and Felix, please don't bring nut granola. Maybe a nut-free alternative? :pray:
Felix: will do nut-free muesli instead. I'll drop it Thursday morning.
